{{Quote|Is it the Mando thing that’s coming between us, dear?''"<br />"''Just my appreciation of the irony that we’re fighting Mando mercenaries in some places.|[[Fi Skirata|Fi]] and Clone Sergeant Barlex|<ref name="True Colors" />}}
'''Parjai Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone airborne troopers]] that served as part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Barlex]], the squad had a reputation for participating in high-risk missions to support [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|special forces]] personnel, with its members holding a unique disdain for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. During the Clone Wars, Parjai Squad helped the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]] para-jump on [[Gaftikar]], and participated in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] towards the war's [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]].

==Description==
Parjai Squad,<ref name="Sith Snapshots" /> whose name meant "victory" in [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]]&mdash;the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Language/Legends|language]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|13|Parjai Squad}}</ref> was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of<ref name="Sith Snapshots" /> nine<ref name="Squads" /> [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone airborne troopers]] that served in one of the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company's]]<ref name="Sith Snapshots" /> [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]],<ref name="Squads" /> as a [[Division/Legends|division]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="Sith Snapshots" /> Under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Barlex]], the squad's [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|senior non-commissioned officer]],<ref name="True Colors" /> and a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]],<ref name="Squads" /> the members of Parjai Squad specialized in high-altitude drops behind enemy lines<ref name="TCSWE" /> and were trained for relentless and efficient combat.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#07: Airborne Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC07airborne.asp}}</ref> 

Equipped with [[Kama/Legends|''kamas'']], bandoliers, and ammunition pouches, Parjai Squad's troopers wore specialized [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] designed for para-jumping. The [[armor/Legends|armor]] sported multiple [[Color/Legends|orange]] stripes<ref name="Sith Snapshots" /> to signify the squad's affiliation with the 2nd Airborne Company.<ref name="Sideshow">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=212th Attack Battalion: Utapau (2nd Airborne Company)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/212th_Attack_Battalion_Utapau_Sideshow_Collectibles.asp}}</ref> The unit's troopers wielded [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]],<ref name="Sith Snapshots" /> using white [[winged jet backpack]]s for their airborne operations.<ref name="True Colors" />

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|I lost ten brothers thanks to [Mandalorians].|Clone Sergeant Barlex|<ref name="True Colors" />}}
[[File:JangoFett-OP.png|thumb|right|250px|Despite being Mandalorian clones themselves, the members of Parjai Squad hated Mandalorians (pictured).]]
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Mandalorian [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Clones">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> and born in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City's]] [[Kamino cloning chamber|cloning facilities]] on the<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Clones" /> Parjai Squad participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="True Colors" /> The squad held a reputation for going on high-risk missions to support members of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], the novelty of which wore off quickly towards the beginning of the war.<ref name="True Colors" /> 

At some point in the war, Parjai Squad's [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]&mdash;Barlex, witnessed ten of his brothers get [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], leading to the members of the squad developing a hostility towards Mandalorians,<ref name="True Colors" /> despite being cloned from one themselves<ref name="Hasbro" /> and their squad name belonging to the Mandalorian language.<ref name="TCSWE" />

===Journey to Mirial===
{{Quote|Nice of you to join us, Omega, and may I be the first to say that you look like a bunch of complete prats?|Clone Sergeant Barlex|<ref name="True Colors" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], fifteen [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]] after the start of the Clone Wars at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Parjai Squad was embarked on the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet's]] auxiliary [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Core Conveyor]]'', with the rest of the 2nd Airborne Company, heading to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] to face off against the Separatist forces stationed there. The squad had orders to deliver some of their extra supplies and ballasts, including the members of the Special Operations Brigade's [[Omega Squad]], to the planet [[Gaftikar]] before they could proceed to Mirial. While handing over extra gear to the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] of Omega Squad, and greeting them aboard the ''Core Conveyor'', Barlex showed his hostility towards Mandalorians&mdash;taking it out on the members of Omega, as he considered them born-again Mandalorians.<ref name="True Colors" /> 

===Battle of Utapau===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], towards the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars,<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the troopers of Parjai Squad participated in the 212th Attack Battalion's [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|assault]] of the Outer Rim planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] against the Separatist forces stationed there, in an attempt to hunt down and kill [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies]], during [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] hunt for the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|general]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The battle culminated in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] general's death, and the activation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], turning the Republic's clone forces against their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders&mdash;under the pretense of a Jedi rebellion against the Republic,<ref name="RotS" /> and the activation of the [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chips]] implanted into the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] at birth.<ref name="TCW Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> This eventually led to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Republic's successor state, and the transition of all clone troopers into [[clone stormtrooper]]s of the newly formed [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="Sideshow" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parjai Squad first appeared&mdash;albeit unnamed&mdash;in {{Film|III}},<ref name="RotS" /> a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="RotS BTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> The unit was identified in a series of [[Sith Snapshots]], promotional pictures posted on the [[StarWars.com]] website, as promotion for the movie's release.<ref name="Sith Snapshots" />
